climate_pressure: Long dry spells and reliance on rainwater.
documented_impact: Inadequate household storage increases dependence on shared water distribution.
fcv_mediator: Unequal access and competition at constrained water points.
possible_consequence: NAP reports water theft/disputes and community stress, without incidence or causal estimates.
alternative_explanations: Storage investment, power reliability, distribution rules and household resources also shape shortages and grievances.
uncertainty: Government NAP synthesis citing CIVRA 2024, not a new event inventory or proof of climate-caused armed violence. No island-specific dispute claim. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
resilience_factors: Storage, inclusive allocation and conflict-sensitive assistance are identified responses; effects are unevaluated.
compact_statement: Tuvalu's NAP links dry spells and insufficient storage with shared-water disputes; local frequency and distribution remain unknown.
